svg.title: FALCON-01 Carrier PCB physical fit sheet
svg.text: Print on A4 portrait at 100% / Actual size. Disable Fit, Shrink, and Scale to page.
Measure the 50 mm calibration bar before placing any component. Black dot marks pad 1.
FIT RESULT: ☐ PASS ☐ FAIL Scale measured: __________ mm / 50.00 mm
Do not drill, fabricate, or route final copper from this sheet until every critical footprint is physically verified.
